subject: pol-dy
title: POL.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 299 (WI-15). POL-DY (political dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-RT (information reality), IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and R-TM. From INFO-RT: IST-F-ACT. From IF-ST-DY: V-SY (value system). From R-TM: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From V-SY: VT-ATT (vibrational attitude). From APP-RDEF: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From ACC-DY: CN-INFO (controlled information) and PROG-SIGN (progressional significance).
